title: Squats
statementMd:
Pasha has many hamsters and he makes them work out. Today, $*n*$ hamsters ($*n*$ is even) came to work out. The hamsters lined up and each hamster either sat down or stood up.

For another exercise, Pasha needs exactly ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png) hamsters to stand up and the other hamsters to sit down. In one minute, Pasha can make some hamster ether sit down or stand up. How many minutes will he need to get what he wants if he acts optimally well?

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 200$; $*n*$ is even). The next line contains $*n*$ characters without spaces. These characters describe the hamsters' position: the $*i*$-th character equals '`X`', if the $*i*$-th hamster in the row is standing, and '`x`', if he is sitting.

## Output

In the first line, print a single integer — the minimum required number of minutes. In the second line, print a string that describes the hamsters' position after Pasha makes the required changes. If there are multiple optimal positions, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

Pasha 有许多只仓鼠，他会让仓鼠进行锻炼。今天，有 $*n*$ 只仓鼠（$*n*$ 为偶数）来锻炼。仓鼠们排成一列，每只仓鼠要么坐着，要么站着。

为了进行另一项锻炼，Pasha 需要恰好让 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png) 只仓鼠站着，其余仓鼠坐着。Pasha 每分钟可以让任意一些仓鼠坐下或站起。如果他采取最优策略，需要多少分钟才能达到目标？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 200$；$*n*$ 为偶数）。下一行包含一个不含空格的长度为 $*n*$ 的字符串。这些字符描述了仓鼠们的位置：如果队列中第 $*i*$ 只仓鼠站着，则第 $*i*$ 个字符为 '`X`'；如果它坐着，则第 $*i*$ 个字符为 '`x`'。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数——所需的最少分钟数。第二行输出一个字符串，表示 Pasha 完成所需修改后仓鼠们的位置。如果存在多个最优位置，输出其中任意一个即可。
